description: Why a chat's folder (a worktree that's gone) couldn't be made again, and where to /cd to carry on: said in the chat by Baude and by the host process.

messages.carry_on_in_project: {$why}: /cd {$folder} to carry on in the project folder
messages.carry_on_elsewhere: {$why}: /cd to another folder to carry on
messages.repo_gone: {$repo} no longer exists, and worktree {$name} with it
messages.not_a_repo: worktree {$name} is gone, and {$repo} isn't a git repository to make it again from
messages.branch_elsewhere: worktree {$name} is gone, and its branch {$branch} is checked out in {$path}
messages.checkout_failed: worktree {$name} is gone, and git couldn't check out its branch {$branch} again
messages.branch_gone: worktree {$name} is gone, and so is its branch
